title: Unit Test Acceptance Contract
description: Criteria for a well-written unit test. Used to evaluate single-function/class tests in isolation.

dimensions.name: Assertion clarity
dimensions.criterion: Each assertion documents what is being verified and why it matters

levels.definition: All assertions have inline comments OR descriptive assert messages that explain the criterion
70%+ of assertions have comments/messages; remaining are self-evident from context
Assertions lack context; reader must infer intent from code structure alone

dimensions.name: Test independence
dimensions.criterion: Test does not depend on external state, run order, or side effects from other tests

levels.definition: Test has setup fixture; no shared state, no DB dependencies, no test ordering assumptions
Test is mostly isolated but has minor setup assumptions or mocked external calls
Test reads/modifies shared mutable state or has undeclared dependencies on other tests

dimensions.name: Test determinism
dimensions.criterion: Test produces same verdict on every run (no flake)

levels.definition: Test passes or fails consistently; no sleep() calls, floating-point comparisons, or timing assumptions
Test mostly deterministic but has minor timing-dependent logic or occasional external calls
Test has sleep() calls, floating-point equality checks, or external service dependencies without mocks

dimensions.name: Test focus
dimensions.criterion: Test verifies ONE thing; not a multi-scenario integration

levels.definition: Test has one logical assertion target; test name describes exactly what it verifies
Test verifies 2–3 related behaviors; still reasonably focused
Test verifies many unrelated behaviors; looks more like an integration test

passing_criteria: All dimensions at PASS level, OR weighted average score >= 0.85
